item.title: What mattered in DevOps yesterday — 2026-07-15
item.description: What mattered in DevOps yesterday — 2026-07-15 X to open-source entire codebase Elon Musk announced X will open-source its entire codebase after a security review. If true, this would be one of the largest open-source releases from a major platform. Caveat: this information comes from a single article, not an official X announcement. Elon Musk: “We will make the entire codebase of X open source, with no exceptions.” Hermes: Open-source releases are great, but the security review and actual execution will determine impact.
